name: SERBIA

flag.title: Serbian Flag
flag.note: Red, blue & white with golden coat of arms

lead: Serbia is in the middle of the Balkans. Roman roads, Ottoman spice markets, and Belgrade nightlife all meet here. The Danube and Sava rivers join in Belgrade. Serbia is small but bold, loud but warm.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Serbia has no coast. The north is the flat Pannonian Plain, with sunflowers to the horizon. The south has mountains. The Danube flows 588 km through Serbia.
Tara National Park has deep gorges and Pančić's spruce, a tree found nowhere else on Earth. At Đerdap, the Danube squeezes between 300 m cliffs.
animals: Brown bears, grey wolves, and the rare Eurasian lynx live in Serbia's forests. The Danube wetlands host over 300 bird species. White-tailed eagles have wings wider than a grown-up's arms.
The great bustard lives on the northern plains. It is the world's heaviest flying bird. In spring, it puffs up like a balloon to show off.
culture: Guests never leave hungry in Serbia. Tables hold burek (flaky pastry), roast lamb, and ajvar, a sweet, smoky red pepper relish. Families jar ajvar together on autumn weekends.
Brass bands shake the Guča festival each August. Slava is a family's patron-saint feast day. UNESCO listed it in 2014.
history: Romans, Byzantines, and Ottomans all ruled Serbia. In the 1300s, Tsar Dušan's empire stretched from the Danube to the Aegean. The Ottomans held Serbia for nearly 400 years, until uprisings in 1804 won self-rule.
Serbia sat at the centre of both World Wars, then joined Yugoslavia. It became an independent republic again in 2006. Belgrade is now one of Europe's fastest-growing capitals.
wows: Serbia is Europe's biggest raspberry grower and top exporter of frozen raspberries.
Tesla, inventor of AC electricity, was born in 1856 to a Serbian family.
Belgrade has been destroyed and rebuilt 44 times.
The Đerdap Gorge is over 100 km long, Europe's longest river gorge.
Serbian street signs use Cyrillic and Latin side by side.
Exit festival in Novi Sad began as a student protest in 2000.
Home-distilled slivovitz plum brandy has UNESCO heritage status.

myths.myth: A raspberry is a true berry
myths.fact: Not to scientists. A raspberry is a cluster of tiny fruits, each with its own seed.
Wolves howl to talk to their pack. The moon has nothing to do with it.
